response.sql: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_stats) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.byte_rate - b.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_excess FROM media_stats AS m CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE m.byte_rate > b.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: NULL Bytes are omitted from the byte total; all tracks still contribute to the millisecond total. A media type with no known Bytes has a NULL rate and is excluded from the averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat NULL Bytes as zero bytes.
alternatives.sql: WITH media_stats AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(Bytes, 0)) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_rate FROM media_stats) SELECT AVG(m.avg_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.byte_rate - b.avg_rate) AS avg_rate_excess FROM media_stats AS m CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE m.byte_rate > b.avg_rate
